name: Teak 2-Door Wardrobe
description: Solid teak 2-door wardrobe with hanging space, shelves and two drawers. Classic locking design, ideal for bedroom storage.
details: This solid teak 2-door wardrobe offers practical bedroom storage with a hanging section on one side and shelves plus two drawers on the other. Both doors have locks and silver handles. The classic panel design and crown top give a traditional look. Strong teak construction makes it durable and suitable for everyday use in Sri Lankan homes.
